skill.name: backend-migrations
skill.description: Create reversible, focused database migrations with proper naming, version control practices, and zero-downtime deployment considerations. Use this skill when creating or editing migration files in database/migrations/, when writing schema changes (creating/modifying tables, columns, indexes, foreign keys), when implementing migration rollback methods, when managing database version control, when adding or modifying indexes on large tables, or when separating schema changes from data migrations for safer deployments.

content.value_statement: Database schema changes can break deployments when migrations lack rollback plans or compatibility checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward focused migrations.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of new migration files under database/migrations/.
Prompts careful editing of existing migrations that may already be deployed.
Covers table, column, index, constraint, and foreign key changes.
Emphasizes rollback methods for reversible database changes.
Supports planning for zero-downtime and backwards-compatible deployments.
Encourages separating schema migrations from data migrations.
limitations: The skill provides guidance only; it does not execute migrations.
It references external migration standards that are outside the packaged skill file.
It does not inspect live database state or production traffic.
It does not replace framework-specific migration documentation.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Schema Change
use_cases.description: Create a focused migration with clear naming, reversible steps, and deployment considerations.

use_cases.title: Review a Risky Migration
use_cases.description: Check an existing migration for rollback gaps, large-table index risks, and backwards compatibility concerns.

use_cases.title: Separate Data and Schema Work
use_cases.description: Design safer release steps when schema changes and record updates should not run together.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reversible backend migration for this schema change: [describe the table, columns, and constraints].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new database migration.

prompt_templates.title: Add an Index Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a migration to add this index on a large table: [table and columns]. Include deployment risks and rollback steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on performance and production safety.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this migration plan for reversibility, naming, backwards compatibility, and zero-downtime concerns: [paste summary].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before committing or deploying migration work.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe migration sequence for this feature: [describe schema change, data migration, and application rollout].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for coordinated schema, data, and application releases.

output_examples.input: Add a nullable customer reference to invoices with a rollback plan.
output_examples.output: A migration plan with a clear file name, forward change, rollback behavior, and compatibility notes for older application code.

output_examples.input: Review a migration that renames a column used by production services.
output_examples.output: A risk review that recommends staged compatibility, temporary dual writes, rollback limits, and deployment order.

output_examples.input: Add an index to a high-volume activity table.
output_examples.output: A production-focused checklist covering index creation strategy, locking risk, monitoring, and rollback expectations.

best_practices: Keep each migration focused on one logical schema change.
Write a rollback path before treating the migration as complete.
Plan large-table indexes and incompatible changes as staged deployments.
anti_patterns: Do not mix broad schema refactors with unrelated data updates.
Do not edit deployed migrations without understanding downstream environments.
Do not assume a column rename is safe for running application code.

faq.question: Does this skill run database migrations?
faq.answer: No. It provides migration planning and authoring guidance for an AI coding assistant.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with rollback methods?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly covers rollback and down methods for reversible changes.

faq.question: Can it handle zero-downtime deployments?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for backwards-compatible and zero-downtime migration planning.

faq.question: Is it specific to one database engine?
faq.answer: No database engine is declared in the skill file. Confirm framework and engine details before applying guidance.

faq.question: What is the main audit concern?
faq.answer: The skill links to a parent-directory file outside the reviewed package, which should be bundled or removed.
